_doc: Host<->plugin UI slot contract. Each slot is a keyed data-surface template the host renders for registered plugin components, plus the registry method(s) that fill it. `host` is the component that renders the slot. A slot is `verified` when the host actually renders its template id as data-surface (checked by the scanner); an unverified slot carries a `reason` and must be instrumented at its host or stay explicitly unverified. Owned via CODEOWNERS. The UI Surface CI job diffs this contract to block breaking removals.
